training_samples.response_template_english:
🔐 **Password Requirements**

Your password must have:

✅ At least 8 characters
✅ Uppercase letter (A-Z)
✅ Lowercase letter (a-z)
✅ Number (0-9)
✅ Special character (!@#$%^&*)

**Examples:**
✅ Strong: `Batangas@2024`
✅ Strong: `Buyer123!`
❌ Weak: `password123`
❌ Weak: `buyer2024`

💡 **Tips:**
• Use a phrase you'll remember
• Add numbers and symbols
• Don't use personal info (birthday, name)
training_samples.response_template_tagalog:
🔐 **Mga Requirement sa Password**

Ang iyong password ay dapat may:

✅ Hindi bababa sa 8 characters
✅ May malaking letra (A-Z)
✅ May maliit na letra (a-z)
✅ May numero (0-9)
✅ May special character (!@#$%^&*)

**Halimbawa:**
✅ Malakas: `Batangas@2024`
✅ Malakas: `Buyer123!`
❌ Mahina: `password123`
❌ Mahina: `buyer2024`

💡 **Tips:**
• Gumamit ng pariralang madaling tandaan
• Magdagdag ng numero at symbols
• Huwag gamitin ang personal info

training_samples.response_template_english:
📱 **Phone Number Format**

Accepted formats:

✅ **09171234567** (11 digits, recommended)
✅ **+639171234567** (with country code)
✅ **639171234567** (without +)

**Example:**
If your number is 0917-123-4567, enter as: `09171234567`

❌ **Don't use:**
• Spaces: 0917 123 4567
• Dashes: 0917-123-4567
• Parentheses: (0917)1234567
• +09: +09171234567

💡 **Note:** Valid number is required for agents to contact you about properties you're interested in.
training_samples.response_template_tagalog:
📱 **Format ng Phone Number**

Tinatanggap na format:

✅ **09171234567** (11 digits, recommended)
✅ **+639171234567** (may country code)
✅ **639171234567** (walang +)

**Halimbawa:**
Kung ang numero mo ay 0917-123-4567, ilagay bilang: `09171234567`

❌ **Iwasan ang:**
• Spaces: 0917 123 4567
• Gitling: 0917-123-4567
• Parenthesis: (0917)1234567
• +09: +09171234567

💡 **Paalala:** Kailangan ang wastong numero para makontak ka ng agents tungkol sa mga property na interesado ka.

training_samples.response_template_english:
🔄 **Forgot Password**

To reset your password:

**Steps:**
1️⃣ Click **'Forgot Password?'** on login page
2️⃣ Enter your registered email
3️⃣ Check inbox for reset link (valid 1 hour)
4️⃣ Click the link
5️⃣ Create new password

**Password requirements:**
• 8+ characters
• Uppercase & lowercase
• Number & special character

💡 **Didn't get email?** Check spam folder or try again after 5 minutes.

training_samples.response_template_english:

**Method 1:**
• Go to login page
• Try to login
• Click **'Resend Code'** when 'Email Not Verified' appears

**Method 2:**
• If you're on verification page, click **'Resend Code'** button

💡 New code will be sent to your email. Check spam folder if not received!

training_samples.response_template_tagalog:

• Subukang mag-login
• I-click ang **'Resend Code'** kapag lumabas ang 'Email Not Verified'

**Paraan 2:**
• Kung nasa verification page ka, i-click ang **'Resend Code'** na button

💡 May bagong code na ipapadala sa iyong email. Tingnan ang spam folder kung hindi dumating!

⚠️ Maximum 5 beses magpa-resend kada oras.

training_samples.response_template_english:
⚠️ **Login Troubleshooting**

**Common issues & fixes:**

**❌ 'Invalid email or password'**
• Check Caps Lock is off
• Verify email spelling
• Try 'Forgot Password?' to reset

**❌ 'Email not verified'**
• Check inbox for verification code
• Say 'resend code' for new one

**❌ 'Account not found'**
• Did you sign up as buyer?
• Need to create account first

**❌ 'Too many attempts'**
• Wait 15 minutes
• Reset your password

💡 Still stuck? Say 'contact support' for help!
training_samples.response_template_tagalog:
⚠️ **Pag-troubleshoot ng Login**

**Karaniwang issues at solusyon:**

**❌ 'Invalid email or password'**
• Tignan kung naka-off ang Caps Lock
• I-double check ang spelling ng email
• Subukan ang 'Forgot Password?' para mag-reset

**❌ 'Email not verified'**
• Tingnan ang inbox para sa verification code
• Sabihin 'resend code' para sa bago

**❌ 'Account not found'**
• Nag-sign up ka ba bilang buyer?
• Kailangan mo munang gumawa ng account

**❌ 'Too many attempts'**
• Maghintay ng 15 minuto
• I-reset ang iyong password

💡 Stuck pa rin? Sabihin 'contact support' para sa tulong!
